name: plugin.tau_harness_bridge
description: Pi-style minimalist coding agent harness bridge providing branchable session tree DAGs, append-only JSONL journal locking, in-flight provider-safe tool history repair, and project-trust security gating (Tau v0.4.4 / twotimespi)
author: Brain Harness

entrypoints.name: tau_session_fork
entrypoints.description: Traverse branchable session tree DAG entries and resolve linear ancestry path from root to target entry

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: List of session entries containing id and parent_id attributes

parameters.name: target_id
parameters.description: ID of the target fork entry to resolve

entrypoints.name: tau_tool_history_repair
entrypoints.description: Normalize message history in-flight to repair orphan tool responses or unresponded assistant tool calls

parameters.name: messages
parameters.description: Raw conversation messages to normalize before LLM submission

entrypoints.name: tau_project_trust_eval
entrypoints.description: Evaluate workspace security boundaries, git root inheritance, and sensitive file exposures

parameters.name: project_path
parameters.description: Canonical path to the workspace root directory

entrypoints.name: tau_rpc_session_dispatch
entrypoints.description: Format or dispatch a Pi-compatible JSONL RPC protocol envelope for headless runner execution
